title: How to sell better than 99%: Hormozi's 4-hour sales masterclass on closing, objections and scaling teams
summary: Compilation of Hormozi's best sales talks: closing as logical decision help, the three-bucket objection map (circumstances, others, self), the CLOSER framework, tone and conviction, and how to scale and compensate a sales team. Includes real case numbers on show rate, close rate and in-house vs outsourced sales.

principles.text: Every objection is a distortion that falls into three buckets: circumstances (time, money, fit), other people, or self. Peel them layer by layer.
principles.quote: the objections that people offer you where they cast their power to are distortions of reality

principles.text: Handle obstacles before price is mentioned; after price they become much harder objections. Kill zombies up front.
principles.quote: it's much easier to address things before you ask for money than after if you do it after it's called an objection

principles.text: Close by resolving the concern and asking again. Sales volume is proportional to how many times you ask.
principles.quote: if you do not ask for the sale you will not get it that is a promise once you ask if you ask again you'll increase the likelihood that they buy

principles.text: Sell the destination, not the process. Keep the pitch under three minutes and tell short stories instead of features.
principles.quote: sell the vacation not the plane fright

principles.text: Best closers listen about twice as much as they talk and answer questions with questions.
principles.quote: the best best salespeople listen twice as much as they talk

principles.text: Conviction fixes tone. Belief in the product transfers more than script skill, so fix the product and reread testimonials.
principles.quote: conviction will correct your tone if you believe in what you sell you will say it the right way
